sql: select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, strategy, status, side, count(*) n, sum(quantity) qty,  round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) pnl, round(sum(fees)::numeric,4) fees,  round((100*sum(fees)/nullif(sum(quantity),0))::numeric,4) fee_c_per_ct,  round(avg(assumed_price)::numeric,1) avg_px, min(created_at)::date first, max(created_at)::date last,  count(*) filter (where resolved_value not in (0,100)) odd_res, min(fill_assumption) fa from paper_trades where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH') group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,2,3,4
